Instrument.name: Instrument
Instrument.definition: Data related to the identification of an instrument.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Description of the status of the financial instrument.

StatusStartDateTime.name: Status Start Date Time
StatusStartDateTime.definition: Date and time from which the instrument status is valid.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Identification of the trading venue on which the instrument status is valid.

TradingSystem.name: Trading System
TradingSystem.definition: Information about the trading system where the instrument is traded.

MostRelevantMarket.name: Most Relevant Market
MostRelevantMarket.definition: Identification of the trading venue being the most relevant market.||Usage: Only applicable for the output data of the Equity Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).

DisseminationDateTime.name: Dissemination Date Time
DisseminationDateTime.definition: Date and time from which the instrument status or the data are disseminated by the Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP).||Usage: Only applicable for output data.
